CA.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation relation to the identified contents was found (A absent).

COD.rationale: Content (C) and status/origin metadata (D) are explicit, but the organization/presentation evidence is general (e.g. grid mapping) and not explicitly bound to the same referent/time required for an explicit COD binding.

A.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation or content-processing condition is linked to the identified contents' presentation/access.

C.rationale: The report lists explicit content tokens (color labels) bound to coordinate sets for named records.

D.rationale: The report separately records origin/execution metadata for named contents, distinguishing identification from provenance/status.

evidence.quote: Current and conditional candidate peaks follow.

O.rationale: The text states how coordinates map to rows/columns and notes current vs candidate presentation peaks, describing presentation/organization properties.
